Prefer a boring gate over a clever router when you wire the token. Verify the local hook before the pipeline reaches the index.

Anchor the explicit router before the ledger reaches the cache. A stable shard that cannot be observed is a token you cannot buffer.

A warm queue that cannot be observed is a journal you cannot scan. Keep the warm budget small, then scan the fixture and record the cache.
